name: Randgold & Exploration Company Limited
source: Randgold & Exploration Company Limited notice of annual general meeting and summarised group financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (https://randgoldexp.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Randgold-Exploration-Company-Ltd-Notice-of-the-AGM-13-May-2026.pdf), summarised group statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, audited by KPMG Inc. with an unmodified opinion, in rand thousands. FY2025: personnel expenses (10 090), change in fair value of investments in securities 2 297, other operating expenses (7 084), loss from operating activities (14 877), finance income 3 713, loss before taxation (11 164), taxation nil, loss for the year (11 164). FY2024: (10 063), 2 353, (9 465), (17 175), 5 091, (12 084), nil, (12 084). CRON 20261112: Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Net Finance Costs filled from that statement, the same figures already carried by RNG.JO and confirmed against the issuer summary; Operating Expenses is personnel plus other operating expenses less the fair value movement 2 297 (2024: 2 353) because the fixed label set has no row for it, so EBIT equals the printed loss from operating activities and EBIT plus Net Finance Costs equals the printed loss before taxation exactly.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
